rejected_shapes.shape_doc: the canonical form with a sentence-final period
rejected_shapes.classification: grader-rule problem: `_integral_numeral` treats a sentence-final period as punctuation for NUM, but `_parse_call`'s `\)\s*$` and NONE's exact `head == 'NONE'` do not, so the same punctuation is a parse error on CALL and NONE
rejected_shapes.named_fix: strip a single sentence-final period before the CALL/NONE branch in grade_v5.parse_answer_contract

rejected_shapes.shape_doc: a CALL with kwargs in a DIFFERENT order (e1), and the same with the provenance detail appended after the closing paren (e2)
rejected_shapes.classification: grader-rule problem: the fixture system prompt allows `A citation written after the value is allowed and is not the value` and det_verify.asserted_number strips it for NUM, but grade_v5 has no CALL equivalent, so the citation is folded into the last kwarg value or breaks the call parse
rejected_shapes.named_fix: strip a trailing parenthetical provenance citation before `_parse_call` in grade_v5.parse_answer_contract (mirror of det_verify.citation_spans)

rejected_shapes.shape_doc: NONE carrying an em-dash justification (`ANSWER: NONE - the source defines no such call`)
rejected_shapes.classification: fixture-wording problem: the fixture's NONE form is the bare `ANSWER: NONE`, and the parser enforces it (`trailing_after_none`)
rejected_shapes.named_fix: either document the em-dash justification in the fixture contract line or relax `trailing_after_none` for a NONE body whose extra text carries no value

grid_quality_precondition.why: a correct era-B answer in shape(s) b_trailing_period, e2_reordered_plus_provenance, f_none_with_justification grades answer_not_contract/kwarg_value_mismatch/unparseable, so the 1,016-request grid can manufacture a fifth zero on turns where era B emits those shapes
